name: V8-A2 reliability layer
control: Existing frozen V8-A remains authority and is not replaced.

rank.definition: fraction of immediately prior 288 A2 scores <= current score

scope_warning: Historical state precision/lift claims are validated on factual V8 event decisions. Continuous every-M5 output outside events is context only.
calibration_policy: Do not auto-refit/recalibrate. Raw probability is model estimate; rank/state is the preferred regime-relative reliability signal.
monthly_result: HIGH and EXTREME beat each calendar month's event base movement rate in all 32 evaluated months for P15/P30/P60 when state_n>=10.
prospective: Use V8A2ProspectiveLoggerEA. Do not backfill the prospective ledger.
